bibl.title: The Tale of the Theban Scholastikos, or Journeys in a Disconnected Sea.
bibl.seg: Rebecca Darley, The Tale of the Theban Scholastikos, or Journeys in a Disconnected Sea.
bibl.note: Connectivity, pre-modernity, and the global hierarchy of value. - The tale of the Theban scholastikos. - The Roman Empire. - The Aksumite Empire. - India. - Conclusion: visualizing a disconnected Late Antiquity. - What emerges is an initial framing of the western Indian Ocean in Late Antiquity as a space in which long-distance connections continued from earlier centuries and in some places even thrived, but were systematically devalued both politically and ideologically, with concrete effects for those involved.
